correctness.rationale: For any finite numerical semigroup, degrees with >=2 factorizations are the union of Betti translates B+S, by minimal presentation chains; for four tetrahedral generators Robles-Perez/Rosales Corollary34 supplies 6-case degrees. Explicit positive differences of Betti degrees in classes 0,2,3 prove principal multiple-representation ideal b+S. In classes 1,4,5 Frobenius symmetry and displayed F-D certificates show other Betti degree not in b+S, so not principal and strict g1 bound. For principal classes Ap(S,b) and F, symmetric genus give g1=F+b, H1=(F+1)/2+b. Independently enumerated representations and memberships n=4..12: principal exactly residues 0,2,3; n6 b168 F1243 g1 1411; n7 F1571 g1 1991. Read RESULT.md and verify.py; symbolic all-k identities, not finite tests, underwrite universal proof.

evidence: Robles-Perez/Rosales 2017/2018 full primary article Section 4.3 proves freeness, gives six Betti degrees and an Apéry set wrt tetrahedral generator; it does not state the principal multiple-factorization ideal criterion, Apéry wrt minimum Betti, nor generalized first Frobenius/genus shifts. Related Resultary catenary-degree law uses the Betti data for different invariant; Komatsu 2022 covers triangular triples. Thus original statement is a novel derived classification, not simply quoted old Betti table.
